_note: Every scheme term comes from the source listed. Names in 'anon' are invented. 'pair' links each fraud to its matched legitimate case. Amounts are in naira unless stated.

fraud.pitch: It is a mutual aid community: members provide help to each other and get help back.
fraud.terms: It pays 30% a month on whatever you put in.

fraud.pitch: It is a giving circle that runs on WhatsApp. You join a circle of 8 people, and when the circle fills up the person in the centre collects.
fraud.terms: You pay 13,000 naira and get back 8 times that, 104,000 naira, within 48 hours. You have to invite at least one person to join.
fraud.horizon: two full rounds of the circle

fraud.pitch: It is a peer-to-peer donation platform: you donate to another member, then other members donate back to you.
fraud.terms: You get 100% interest on your donation, so you receive double what you gave.

fraud.pitch: It is a forex trading company. Their traders trade your money and pay you every month.
fraud.source: Press reports on MBA Forex, 2018 to 2021

fraud.pitch: It is affiliate marketing: you share their sponsored posts on Facebook every day and they pay you. They say they also do real estate, forex and gadgets.
fraud.terms: There are packages: the Standard one costs 14,000 naira and becomes 21,600 naira after 30 days. The package I want costs 280,000 naira and becomes 444,600 naira after 30 days.
fraud.horizon: the next 6 months if I keep renewing

fraud.pitch: It is a group of businesses in real estate, logistics and food. Popular people on Facebook advertise it.
fraud.terms: It pays 3% every month on your investment.
fraud.source: Tekedia, The Chinmarkgate (3% monthly); SEC Nigeria, 25 Dec 2021

fraud.pitch: It is a farm investment company. Your money funds farms and you share in the profit.
fraud.terms: Minimum is 100,000 naira and it pays 10% every month. It used to pay 20% a month but they reduced it.
fraud.source: BusinessDay (Famzhi: N100,000 minimum, 10% monthly, earlier 20% then 15%); SEC Nigeria, 19 Jun 2024 (boss jailed)

fraud.pitch: It is a crypto trading platform that uses AI to trade for you.
fraud.terms: It pays 100% in 30 days. To withdraw you need to bring in new members.
fraud.source: Naija News Feeds, 2026 (100% in 30 days); SEC Nigeria, 17 Apr and 11 Jun 2025

fraud.pitch: You earn by streaming music and doing small online tasks in their app.
fraud.terms: Packages go from 21,600 naira up to millions and pay up to 100% in 30 days. After the free trial you pay a work deposit to unlock your full earnings. I want the 300,000 naira package.

fraud.pitch: It is read-and-earn: you pay a joining fee, read short articles in the app every day, and refer friends.
fraud.terms: VIP levels cost from 18,900 to 174,000 naira. The top level pays up to 6,000 naira a day. They show a CAC certificate and say the headquarters is in the US.

fraud.pitch: It is a digital marketing company, not an investment: you do daily ad tasks and they pay you.
fraud.terms: The 64,800 naira package pays about 2,160 naira a day from tasks, which is 777,600 naira over 360 days. Withdrawals are weekly, on the day assigned to your level.
fraud.source: Saturday Punch via Kola King, Sep 2026; Legit.ng

legit.pitch: It is a fixed savings plan in a savings app that is registered with the SEC. You lock your money for a period you choose.
legit.terms: It pays up to 22% a year if you lock for 365 days, and the interest is paid upfront when you lock.
legit.source: WithinNigeria, 1 Jul 2026 (PiggyVest SafeLock up to 22% p.a., interest upfront)

legit.pitch: It is a rotating savings group (ajo) of 8 people on our street. Everyone contributes every week and one person collects the pot each week.
legit.terms: Each person pays 13,000 naira a week, so whoever collects that week gets 104,000 naira. There is no interest: over 8 weeks you pay 104,000 naira and collect 104,000 naira once.
legit.horizon: two full rounds of the group
legit.source: Standard rotating savings structure; amounts matched to F2

legit.pitch: It is a fixed deposit with a digital microfinance bank licensed by the CBN.
legit.terms: It pays up to 15% a year, minimum 5,000 naira, for periods from 30 days.
legit.source: TheCondia (Kuda fixed deposit up to 15% p.a., N5,000 minimum, from 30 days)

legit.pitch: It is a dollar mutual fund run by an SEC-registered fund manager. It invests mainly in Nigerian government Eurobonds.
legit.terms: It has returned about 9.5% in dollars so far this year. Returns are not guaranteed.
legit.source: nairaCompare, Q3 2026 (Chapel Hill Denham Nigeria Dollar Income Fund 9.52% YTD, SEC data 14 Aug 2026)

legit.pitch: It is a money market fund run by an SEC-registered asset manager. It invests in treasury bills and bank deposits.
legit.terms: It has returned about 19.4% a year so far. Returns are not guaranteed and change with interest rates.
legit.source: Money market fund rankings, Sep 2026 YTD (STL MMF 19.39%)

legit.pitch: It is the Federal Government savings bond, sold by the Debt Management Office through stockbrokers.
legit.terms: The 3-year bond pays 14.25% a year, with interest paid every quarter. Minimum is 5,000 naira.
legit.source: DMO FGN Savings Bond offer, Nov 2026

legit.pitch: It is a Federal Government treasury bill bought through my bank.
legit.terms: The 364-day bill went at 15.80% at the last auction.

legit.pitch: It is a Federal Government treasury bill bought through my bank, which I would roll over when it matures.
legit.terms: The 91-day bill went at 15.40% a year at the last auction.

legit.pitch: It is an emergency fund savings plan in an investment app licensed by the SEC as a fund manager.
legit.terms: It pays 13.27% a year and I can withdraw when I need to.
legit.source: TechCabal, 20 Nov 2025 (Cowrywise emergency fund 13.27% p.a.); Cowrywise SEC licence

legit.pitch: It is the Federal Government savings bond, sold by the Debt Management Office through stockbrokers.
legit.terms: The 2-year bond pays 13.25% a year, with interest paid every quarter. Minimum is 5,000 naira.
legit.source: DMO FGN Savings Bond offer, Nov 2026

legit.pitch: It is a money market fund run by an SEC-registered asset manager.
legit.terms: It has returned about 21% a year so far, one of the top funds. Returns are not guaranteed.
legit.source: Money market fund rankings, Sep 2026 YTD (top 10 range 19.01% to 21.43%)
